# Photo Time Machine

> Photo Time Machine turns any photo, photo set or video into a shareable 3D memory: a Gaussian splat or mesh you can explore in a browser or in XR. It is part of the Companion Intelligence platform (https://ci.computer/).

This site serves the web viewer. Each browser names the processing server it uses on first visit, and that server runs the 3D reconstruction. Share links (/view/ID) are private and marked noindex. Support: support@ci.computer

## Pages

- [Home](https://photo.ci.computer/): the viewer, and what Photo Time Machine does
- [Docs](https://docs.ci.computer): documentation for Companion Intelligence products

## Optional
